stories.title: Could you have a penny worth $235,000? Rare 1943 coin makes its way to Houston shop
stories.summary: A rare World War II-era penny is valued at $235,000. A Houston coin expert explains what makes it so valuable and how to check your own spare change.

stories.title: What sparked the Clean Harbors explosion? Investigators say key questions remain
stories.summary: Investigators say hydrocarbon vapors caused the Clean Harbors explosion, but the ignition source remains unknown. Two earlier fires are also under scrutiny.

stories.title: 'I'm still numb' | Family questions deadly Crosby road rage shooting involving constable's office dispatcher
stories.summary: The family of a 35-year-old man killed in an apparent road rage shooting in Crosby is mourning his death and questioning why the confrontation turned deadly.

stories.title: ‘I’m one of those miracles’ | Veterans celebrate Harris County treatment court graduation
stories.summary: The Harris County Veterans Treatment Court Program connects veterans facing criminal charges with mental health and addiction treatment.

stories.title: Shooting inside Humble McDonald’s leaves juvenile injured, police say
stories.summary: Police said the injured juvenile is expected to survive. Another juvenile believed to be involved has been detained.

stories.title: Pilot charged in deadly 2024 Houston Ship Channel collision
stories.summary: A ship pilot faces a federal charge alleging his negligence caused a 2024 Houston Ship Channel collision that killed Aquarius Lowman.

stories.title: Fast-growing Houston suburb unanimously approves new e-bike and e-scooter safety ordinance
stories.summary: Fulshear now requires helmets for riders under 18 on public property. Violations could bring fines of up to $500 under the new ordinance.

stories.title: Lockdown lifted at Houston-area hospital
stories.summary: St. Luke’s Health–Pasadena was closed to visitors as police responded to a threat against an individual at the hospital.

stories.title: $5,000 reward offered in hit-and-run that left Channelview teen dead
stories.summary: Jayden Carmona's grandfather remembers the teenager whose smile “just lit up.” Now, a reward could help investigators identify the driver.

stories.title: At least 1 arrested after chase extends from Houston to Winnie, HPD says
stories.summary: At least one person was taken into custody after a lengthy police chase from Houston to Winnie.

stories.title: New Astros parking garage approved near Daikin Park. Here's when it could open
stories.summary: A $52 million parking garage with about 630 spaces is planned near Houston's Daikin Park. See where it will be built and when construction is expected to finish.

stories.title: Carnival announces major change for Galveston cruises in 2028
stories.summary: Carnival Sunshine will sail year-round from Galveston for the first time, with 53 cruises announced for 2028-29, including trips to Mexico and the Caribbean.
